attempts.blocker_detail: vLLM startup failed: at least one 200000-token request required 13.83 GiB KV cache, but only 6.07 GiB was available; estimated max model length was 15104.

A live c64 run completed with zero errors, then a c512 fanout run returned 512 RemoteDisconnected errors; /v1/models was down afterward and Docker logs/containers were no longer available on both nodes.
c64 is not sufficient acceptance for this provider because the same live process died under c512 stress immediately afterward.

do_not_apply: Do not use the prefix-enabled 200k/c512 profile for Spark4/Spark5; c512 stress reproduced rank0/API death despite c64 success.
Do not use max_num_batched_tokens=512 for the 200k-context c512 lane; relaunch showed 512-size graph capture, low KV headroom, worker exit, and Spark4 SSH banner timeouts.
Do not raise max_num_batched_tokens above 8192 for the 200k-context Spark4/Spark5 TP=2 lane without retesting KV capacity.
conclusion.next_code_change: Run the DS4 vLLM launch guard before every Spark4/Spark5 DeepSeek-V4-Flash launch, and only retest c512 after Spark4 is rebooted/recovered.

custom_ds4_lessons_tested.lesson: Larger effective row batches can improve expensive layer utilization.
custom_ds4_lessons_tested.result: Rejected: 16384 was slower and 32768 at 200k context failed KV allocation.

custom_ds4_lessons_tested.lesson: Do not pay for reuse machinery when rows intentionally have distinct prefixes.
custom_ds4_lessons_tested.result: Rejected: explicit no-prefix was slower than the prior prefix-enabled run despite 0.0% observed prefix hits.

custom_ds4_lessons_tested.lesson: The fast custom path is a short-output benchmark rather than long-context serving.
custom_ds4_lessons_tested.result: Rejected: KV capacity fell to 24392 tokens and high fanout queued.
custom_ds4_lessons_tested.vllm_transfer: Use max_model_len=8192 with a larger scheduler token cap.

custom_ds4_lessons_tested.lesson: Candidate-only constrained scoring speeds the custom path by avoiding full-vocab work.
custom_ds4_lessons_tested.result: Already measured in PR #1186: grammar masking did not improve throughput because it is not candidate-only scoring.

custom_ds4_lessons_tested.lesson: The 3x-4x custom compute win came from DS4 routed-MoE expert-tile/slice-tile8 kernels.
custom_ds4_lessons_tested.result: The measured vLLM run selects MARLIN MXFP4 MoE, not the custom DS4 slice-tile8 path.
custom_ds4_lessons_tested.vllm_transfer: Check whether the standard vLLM stack activates an equivalent path.

selected_config.reason: Fastest measured c512 config that explicitly disabled prefix caching; a later prefix-enabled stress rerun killed rank0/API and invalidated the older faster prefix-enabled selection.
